name: Taretha's Gift
label: Quest
description: After the step with Lord Aliden Perenolde, Elysa gives up Taretha's pendant and asks only to be left in peace. You carry it back to Krusk in Tarren Mill.
intro: After the step with Lord Aliden Perenolde, Elysa gives up Taretha's pendant and asks only to be left in peace. You carry it back to Krusk in Tarren Mill.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The pendant? Of course you can have it... Take it! I want no memory of him... Just please, please leave in peace...

clips.title: Progress
paras: You've returned, friend. Success to report?

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is strange that the Warchief would expend so much over such a small thing. I do not claim to understand him, but I will follow him, whatever his commands. You did well, friend, no doubt the Warchief will be glad to hear of your success.
